notes.title: Release Date Set!
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 🙌

Prologue Launching This Week! 👨‍🔧

We are very pleased to inform you that the free Prologue of Garage Flipper will be available to play this week! 🥳

 🧰 Prologue premiere: December 8, 2023; 2:00 PM CET! 🧰

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414010/Garage_Flipper_Prologue/

[previewyoutube=9hXtuRKj0tU;full][/previewyoutube]

We have collected enough feedback from you and we are ready for the premiere of the free Prologue. 🤝

So book your date for December 8, 2023, at 2:00 PM CET. and get your hands dirty, we have a garage to flip! 😎

If you have any questions about Prologue, feel free to jump on the Discord server where you can talk directly with our team 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png

See you soon,
Garage Flipper Team
